work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. LXXIII and synopsis 97280–97285 precede explicit protocol 97287–97288. The preamble and all eighteen numbered paragraphs run in order through the named assistants and transumpt clause. Retain the historical notes at 97330–97332, 97461, 97545–97547, 97610, 97673, 97720, 97783 and 98046–98048. The own papal dating clause and printed date are 98076–98079. The following camera endorsement 98081–98110 explicitly concerns these letters and closes with the notary’s signature; retain it as attached source apparatus, without treating its curial issuer as another papal act. LXXIV starts 98113 with its own protocol 98127. Body and column order are coherent.
